scope: EPGShare IT1 as the final public metadata source for personal live TV

precedence.guide: Declared/configured personal guide remains authoritative even when disabled or unavailable; otherwise keep Lume programmes for the channel, and select EPGShare only when the Lume schedule is absent in the retained horizon.
precedence.logo: Keep a declared personal logo; otherwise keep existing valid Lume logo references, and use EPGShare only if no Lume reference is available. A fetch failure does not remove a declared higher-priority logo.
precedence.schedule_selection: Use a single public source per channel; an empty search/date does not merge schedules.
precedence.safety: Existing ambiguous/region/timeshift matching protections, manual exclusions, VOD separation, original streams and public/private credential separation remain enforced.

checks.local_http_regressions: Public gzip, no private Authorization/Cookie/Referer, ETag/Last-Modified, 304, retained-window renewal after 12 hours, persisted 429 pause, invalid gzip/XML preserves prior index
checks.priority_regressions: Lume/programme/logo priorities independently, no fallback on empty date/search in a known primary schedule, primary identity conflict exclusion, personal guide/logo precedence, original playback identity and URL retained
checks.local_api: Programmes, epgshare origin, no archive privileges, and PNG responses verified without exposing personal URLs or headers

limits: Point-in-time EPG coverage is not a guarantee for every channel or editorial correctness of third-party schedules.
Some event channels have no programmes in the source; ambiguous and unmatched channels remain unassigned.
Playback decoding was not retested by this metadata task; real native UI and metadata APIs were verified.
